quests.hint: This verb means to examine something closely and in detail to understand it better.
quests.explanation: 'Analyse data,' 'analyse a situation,' and 'critically analyse' are key. 'Analysis' is the noun. 'Analytical thinking' is a valued skill. 'Detailed analysis' describes thorough work.
quests.textToSpeak: Scientists need to ___ the data carefully before drawing any firm conclusions.
quests.correctAnswer: Scientists need to analyse the data carefully before drawing any firm conclusions.

quests.hint: This verb means to persuade someone to change their mind about something.
quests.explanation: 'Convince someone to do,' 'convince someone that,' and 'hard to convince' are patterns. 'Convincing' is the adjective: 'a convincing argument.' 'Unconvinced' means not persuaded.
quests.textToSpeak: He tried to ___ his parents that moving abroad was absolutely the right decision.
quests.correctAnswer: He tried to convince his parents that moving abroad was absolutely the right decision.

quests.hint: This is a reason or set of reasons given in support of a position or idea.
quests.explanation: 'Make an argument,' 'put forward an argument,' and 'strong argument' are key. 'Argument' can also mean a disagreement. 'Logical argument' uses evidence and reasoning.
quests.textToSpeak: She made a very compelling ___ for increasing the marketing budget significantly.
quests.correctAnswer: She made a very compelling argument for increasing the marketing budget significantly.

quests.hint: This verb means to look at two or more things to find similarities and differences.
quests.explanation: 'Compare prices,' 'compare and contrast,' and 'by comparison' are key. 'Comparable' means similar in value. 'In comparison to' and 'compared with' are connecting phrases.
quests.textToSpeak: When choosing a laptop, it always helps to ___ prices across several websites.
quests.correctAnswer: When choosing a laptop, it always helps to compare prices across several websites.

quests.hint: This is a different option or choice when the usual one is unavailable or unsuitable.
quests.explanation: 'Find an alternative,' 'viable alternative,' and 'no alternative' are key. 'Alternative' can be an adjective ('alternative route') or a noun ('what are the alternatives?').
quests.textToSpeak: If that route is too busy, there is a much quieter ___ through the village.
quests.correctAnswer: If that route is too busy, there is a much quieter alternative through the village.

quests.hint: This is a major news story that receives the most prominent coverage in media.
quests.explanation: 'Make the headlines,' 'national headline,' and 'grab the headlines' are natural. 'Headline news' means the top stories. 'Read the headlines' means to scan the main stories.
quests.textToSpeak: The story made the ___ of every major newspaper across the country that day.
quests.correctAnswer: The story made the headlines of every major newspaper across the country that day.

quests.hint: This noun refers to a clear benefit or superior position over something else.
quests.explanation: 'Competitive advantage,' 'take advantage of,' and 'have an advantage over' are key. 'Advantageous' is the adjective. 'Advantages and disadvantages' is a classic discussion structure.
quests.textToSpeak: One clear ___ of living close to work is saving time on your daily commute.
quests.correctAnswer: One clear advantage of living close to work is saving time on your daily commute.

quests.hint: This is a negative aspect or limitation of a plan, idea, or situation.
quests.explanation: 'Main drawback,' 'one drawback is,' and 'significant drawback' are key. 'Drawback' is similar to 'disadvantage' but less formal. 'Weighing up the drawbacks' means evaluating negatives.
quests.textToSpeak: The main ___ of the plan is that it will cost significantly more than expected.
quests.correctAnswer: The main drawback of the plan is that it will cost significantly more than expected.

quests.hint: This is a chance that, if taken, can lead to success, growth, or improvement.
quests.explanation: 'Seize an opportunity,' 'take an opportunity,' and 'miss an opportunity' are key. 'Golden opportunity' means a rare and valuable chance. 'Window of opportunity' is a limited time.
quests.textToSpeak: She recognised a great ___ to expand her professional network at the conference.
quests.correctAnswer: She recognised a great opportunity to expand her professional network at the conference.

quests.hint: This noun refers to the food you eat on a regular basis or a specific eating plan.
quests.explanation: 'Healthy diet,' 'balanced diet,' and 'go on a diet' are key. 'Diet culture' refers to societal obsession with weight. 'Dietary requirements' refers to specific needs.
quests.textToSpeak: Her doctor recommended a low-sugar ___ to help improve her overall health.
quests.correctAnswer: Her doctor recommended a low-sugar diet to help improve her overall health.

quests.hint: This noun refers to the total amount of energy that food provides, measured per serving.
quests.explanation: 'Count calories,' 'high in calories,' and 'calorie intake' are key. 'Calorie-controlled diet' means carefully managed food intake. 'Empty calories' provide energy but no nutrition.
quests.textToSpeak: She always checks the ___ in her food before deciding whether to order it.
quests.correctAnswer: She always checks the calories in her food before deciding whether to order it.

quests.hint: This noun refers to the science of how food affects health and body function.
quests.explanation: 'Good nutrition,' 'nutrition label,' and 'sports nutrition' are key. 'Nutritious' is the adjective. 'Nutritionist' is the expert. 'Poor nutrition' is linked to many health conditions.
quests.textToSpeak: Good ___ is essential for maintaining high energy levels throughout the working day.
quests.correctAnswer: Good nutrition is essential for maintaining high energy levels throughout the working day.

quests.hint: This noun refers to all the chairs, tables, shelves, and other movable items in a room.
quests.explanation: 'Piece of furniture,' 'buy furniture,' and 'second-hand furniture' are key. 'Furniture' is uncountable - never 'a furniture.' 'Flat-pack furniture' (like IKEA) is assembled at home.
quests.textToSpeak: They bought all new ___ for the living room when they finally moved in.
quests.correctAnswer: They bought all new furniture for the living room when they finally moved in.

quests.hint: This noun refers to the work done to improve or update a building or room.
quests.explanation: 'Kitchen renovation,' 'home renovation,' and 'renovation project' are key. 'Renovate' is the verb. 'Renovation costs' are what you pay. 'Major renovation' means extensive changes.
quests.textToSpeak: The kitchen ___ took three months and cost far more than they had budgeted for.
quests.correctAnswer: The kitchen renovation took three months and cost far more than they had budgeted for.

quests.hint: This noun refers to the decorating and styling of the inside of a room or building.
quests.explanation: 'Interior design,' 'interior designer,' and 'modern interior' are key. 'Interior' as an adjective means inside. 'Interior design' is a professional creative discipline.
quests.textToSpeak: She hired an ___ designer to help her completely transform the look of the flat.
quests.correctAnswer: She hired an interior designer to help her completely transform the look of the flat.

quests.hint: This is a belief, practice, or custom passed down through generations in a group.
quests.explanation: 'Long-standing tradition,' 'family tradition,' and 'uphold a tradition' are key. 'Traditional' is the adjective. 'Break with tradition' means to stop following the established custom.
quests.textToSpeak: It is a family ___ to open gifts on Christmas Eve rather than Christmas morning.
quests.correctAnswer: It is a family tradition to open gifts on Christmas Eve rather than Christmas morning.

quests.hint: This is an inherited collection of cultural achievements, buildings, and practices.
quests.explanation: 'Cultural heritage,' 'world heritage site,' and 'preserve heritage' are key. 'Heritage' is uncountable. A 'UNESCO World Heritage Site' is internationally recognised as valuable.
quests.textToSpeak: The city has a very rich cultural ___ that attracts millions of tourists each year.
quests.correctAnswer: The city has a very rich cultural heritage that attracts millions of tourists each year.

quests.hint: This is something remarkable accomplished through effort, skill, or courage.
quests.explanation: 'Great achievement,' 'sense of achievement,' and 'academic achievement' are key. 'Achieve' is the verb. 'High achiever' is someone who consistently does very well.
quests.textToSpeak: Completing the marathon was a remarkable ___ she was incredibly proud of.
quests.correctAnswer: Completing the marathon was a remarkable achievement she was incredibly proud of.

quests.hint: This is a significant event that marks a stage in progress or a journey.
quests.explanation: 'Reach a milestone,' 'hit a milestone,' and 'career milestone' are key. Originally a stone marking road distances; now used figuratively for any important landmark in progress.
quests.textToSpeak: Getting her first article published was an important ___ in her writing career.
quests.correctAnswer: Getting her first article published was an important milestone in her writing career.

quests.hint: This verb means to successfully deal with a problem or difficult situation.
quests.explanation: 'Overcome a challenge,' 'overcome adversity,' and 'overcome your fears' are key. 'Overcome' is irregular: overcome, overcame, overcome. It is followed by a noun or gerund.
quests.textToSpeak: She had to ___ many significant obstacles before finally achieving her ambitious goal.
quests.correctAnswer: She had to overcome many significant obstacles before finally achieving her ambitious goal.

quests.hint: This means to act on your own without being asked - showing self-motivation.
quests.explanation: 'Take the initiative,' 'show initiative,' and 'on your own initiative' are key. 'Initiative' is highly valued in workplaces. 'Initiative' also means a plan or programme: 'a new initiative.'
quests.textToSpeak: She showed great ___ by reorganising the entire filing system without being asked.
quests.correctAnswer: She showed great initiative by reorganising the entire filing system without being asked.

quests.hint: This adjective describes something done or made with great care and attention to detail.
quests.explanation: 'Meticulous work,' 'meticulous attention to detail,' and 'meticulously planned' are key. It implies no mistakes are made because everything is checked thoroughly. A very positive quality.
quests.textToSpeak: He is ___ about his work - every detail is checked at least three times.
quests.correctAnswer: He is meticulous about his work - every detail is checked at least three times.

quests.hint: This adjective describes a speaker who expresses themselves clearly, fluently, and persuasively.
quests.explanation: 'Eloquent speaker,' 'eloquent response,' and 'speak eloquently' are key. 'Eloquence' is the noun. It implies not just clarity but a certain grace and beauty in expression.
quests.textToSpeak: She delivered an ___ speech that moved the entire audience to tears.
quests.correctAnswer: She delivered an eloquent speech that moved the entire audience to tears.

quests.hint: This noun refers to a person's ability to recover quickly from setbacks and difficulties.
quests.explanation: 'Show resilience,' 'build resilience,' and 'emotional resilience' are key. 'Resilient' is the adjective. It is one of the most valued qualities in modern professional environments.
quests.textToSpeak: Building emotional ___ helps people cope much better with life's many challenges.
quests.correctAnswer: Building emotional resilience helps people cope much better with life's many challenges.

quests.hint: This is a general direction or development that something is moving or changing in over time.
quests.explanation: 'Follow a trend,' 'current trend,' 'latest trend,' and 'emerging trend' are key. 'Trendy' means fashionable. 'Set a trend' means to start a new direction that others follow.
quests.textToSpeak: The marketing team identified a ___ toward more ethical and sustainable products.
quests.correctAnswer: The marketing team identified a trend toward more ethical and sustainable products.

quests.hint: This adjective describes something that is important or meaningful in its effect or size.
quests.explanation: 'Significant improvement,' 'statistically significant,' and 'significant impact' are key. 'Significantly' is the adverb. 'Significant' is more formal than 'big' or 'large.'
quests.textToSpeak: The study found a ___ link between sleep quality and academic performance.
quests.correctAnswer: The study found a significant link between sleep quality and academic performance.

quests.hint: This noun refers to a repeated sequence of behaviour, events, or shapes that are identifiable.
quests.explanation: 'Identify a pattern,' 'recurring pattern,' and 'behaviour pattern' are key. 'Pattern recognition' is an important cognitive skill. 'Fall into a pattern' means to develop a routine.
quests.textToSpeak: After reviewing the data, a clear ___ of behaviour emerged across all the groups.
quests.correctAnswer: After reviewing the data, a clear pattern of behaviour emerged across all the groups.

quests.hint: This adjective describes someone who has met all the requirements to do a particular job.
quests.explanation: 'Highly qualified,' 'well-qualified,' and 'qualified for the role' are key. 'Qualification' is the noun. 'Under-qualified' means lacking the required experience or credentials.
quests.textToSpeak: She is highly ___ for the senior role, with over ten years of relevant experience.
quests.correctAnswer: She is highly qualified for the senior role, with over ten years of relevant experience.

quests.hint: This noun refers to the state of being answerable for your actions and their results.
quests.explanation: 'Take accountability,' 'personal accountability,' and 'hold someone accountable' are key. 'Accountable' is the adjective. Leaders who take accountability build trust within their teams.
quests.textToSpeak: Leaders must take ___ for the decisions they make on behalf of their team.
quests.correctAnswer: Leaders must take accountability for the decisions they make on behalf of their team.

quests.hint: This noun refers to the set of subjects and content taught in a school or course programme.
quests.explanation: 'School curriculum,' 'national curriculum,' and 'follow a curriculum' are key. 'Curriculum vitae' (CV) is different - it means a summary of your education and work history.
quests.textToSpeak: The school updated its ___ to include a much stronger focus on digital literacy.
quests.correctAnswer: The school updated its curriculum to include a much stronger focus on digital literacy.
